scope: iPad environment preparation progress, diagnostics, cancellation and Android boot adapter corrections

swift_bootstrap_tests.method: 7 selected cases plus the subsequently added native cancellation case

checks.streaming_download: real progress before EOF, complete file retained after delegate return
checks.native_installer_cancellation: same caller thread, no storage created after first callback rejects
checks.localization: English and Simplified Chinese string files passed plutil
checks.final_native_cancellation_semantics: uses a non-retryable I/O error so Rust copy/read helpers do not swallow cancellation as Interrupted

physical_observations: Dev 53 rendered timestamped preparation/startup/failure lines; its single JSONL file was read back successfully using devicectl.
Current environment had already been imported. It failed during boot in 0.846 seconds with ENOTDIR, rather than continuing to download.
A local regression reproduced ENOTDIR when the Linux timezone writer encountered Android /etc -> /system/etc. Android boot and live updates now skip this Linux-only file injection.
Dev 54 log records prepare, boot and ready in 0.556 seconds. Timestamped terminal output and a Waydroid window were visible.
The ready event means the embedding has handed control to guest execution. Android desktop first-frame acceptance is pending; the Waydroid surface was black at observation.

Dev 54 subsequently aborted after roughly 205 seconds of Android execution. The device crash report identifies Rust allocation failure in trames_memory::parallel::snapshot::Memory::update_parallel_snapshot, reached through parallel_view and prepare_views. This is a host allocation failure, not a download timeout or proof of desktop readiness.

diagnostics.export: Settings > Diagnostics > Share environment preparation log

limitations: No additional cold reimport of the approximately 1 GB images was performed after adding progress; native ext4/metadata fixtures, real streaming fixtures and physical startup logging cover the affected boundaries.
No Android desktop or application performance success is claimed.
Byte-range download resume and Android timezone property synchronization are not implemented.
No Linux ARM64 CI rerun for this revision; the complete common runtime macOS workflow passed locally.
Stable iPad build 51 and all Mac apps/environments were left unchanged.
Android first boot remains blocked by the separately captured host allocation failure in parallel memory snapshot construction; no fix for that memory subsystem is included here.
The Settings ShareLink is compiled, but its share sheet could not be manually accepted before the independent Android allocation failure. Single-file log readback from the device succeeded.
